ablationRequirement: Scoring retrieval against hierarchy rows requires removing broader and narrower text from the concept input first. The sparse and graph arms read parent and child labels, so an un-ablated run measures recovery of pairs the arms were handed.

canonicalisation.deduplication: ELSST and ICPSR materialise symmetric and inverse edges in both directions; rows are deduplicated to one canonical edge per endpoint pair and relation class.
canonicalisation.endpointLabels: 'label' is the publisher display label and is always present. 'labelRole' is 'preferred' for a descriptor and 'alternate' for an access term, which ICPSR publishes as members carrying only an alternate-role label.
canonicalisation.oneWayInSource: True when the publisher asserted only one direction for this edge. For symmetric SKOS predicates this records a source asymmetry rather than a directed claim.

relationClassMeaning.associative: subject and object are associated; the row is undirected and sorted by IRI
relationClassMeaning.equivalence: subject is the publisher access term; object is the preferred term it directs to
relationClassMeaning.hierarchy: subject is the narrower concept; object is the broader concept (SKOS broader orientation)

provenance.note: Every row is a publisher-asserted intra-vocabulary relation. No RefSpec retrieval arm, scorer, or judge produced any row.
